readme.overview: The Image Tools Module provides comprehensive image processing capabilities for the Virto Commerce platform. It enables automatic thumbnail generation for product images, category banners, and other visual assets stored in blob storage. The module features a **format-agnostic architecture** that supports both raster formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) via [SixLabors.ImageSharp](https://docs.sixlabors.com/articles/imagesharp/index.html) and vector formats (SVG) with native XML manipulation, ensuring scalability without quality loss.
keyFeatures: **Multi-Format Support**: Process raster images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF) and vector graphics (SVG)
`FixedSize` - Proportional fit within specified dimensions with optional padding
`FixedWidth` - Maintain aspect ratio, resize to target width
`FixedHeight` - Maintain aspect ratio, resize to target height
`Crop` - Crop to exact dimensions using configurable anchor positions
**Background Processing**: Batch thumbnail generation via Hangfire jobs with progress tracking
**Event-Driven Generation**: Automatic thumbnail creation on blob upload events
**Incremental Processing**: Only process new or modified images since last run
**Extensible Architecture**: Plugin-based format handlers for easy addition of new formats

notes.forAnalyst: Thumbnails and image variants generated automatically, so one uploaded photo serves a grid, a gallery and a phone.
notes.forArchitect: Three entities and seven migrations over a single dependency (Assets), with four declared events. It reacts to blob changes, which is why an upload produces derivatives without anyone asking.
notes.forDeveloper: Generation is background work driven by asset events — a host without a worker will store originals and never produce variants. Five settings define the option sets; add a size there rather than in code.
reachForItWhen: Product images need consistent sizes across a storefront
Bandwidth or Core Web Vitals matter
Editors should upload once and not think about formats
doNotReachForItWhen: A CDN already transforms images on the fly
You need the original: this module adds variants, it does not replace them
